headline: 摩登大聖導演辭世
context: 《摩登大聖》（The Mask）、《變形怪體》（The Blob）導演查克・羅素（Chuck Russell）辭世，享壽74歲，週三被發現在加州聖地牙哥的住家過世。他的作品曾捧紅金凱瑞（Jim Carrey）、卡麥蓉・狄亞茲（Cameron Diaz）與巨石強森（Dwayne Johnson）等演員。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The film-maker, also behind A Nightmare on Elm Street 3, died on Wednesday in his San Diego home Director Chuck Russell, who helped propel actors such as Jim Carrey , Cameron Diaz and Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson to the Hollywood A-list, was found dead in his San Diego, California, home on Wednesday. He was 74. Russell directed several box office hits in his decades-long career including A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors, The Blob and The Mask. In 2002, his film The Scorpion King featured The Rock in his first leading role. Continue reading...
sources.title: Chuck Russell, director of The Mask and The Blob, dies aged 74

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: His work, including “The Blob,” a remake of the cult 1958 horror movie, was known for its use of brash visual effects.
sources.title: Chuck Russell, Director of ‘The Mask’ and Third ‘Nightmare on Elm Street’ Movie, Dies at 74

voice_text: 《摩登大聖》的導演查克羅素過世了，享壽74歲。他在週三被發現於加州聖地牙哥的家中過世。他的作品捧紅了不少演員，像金凱瑞、卡麥蓉狄亞茲，還有巨石強森。
